summary: The agent read and then rewrote the requirements document in phase P1, saving a version with 12 requirements that covers room details, the overlap rule, time slot rules, browser-stored name and email, server-enforced admin access, self-service rescheduling, admin cancellation and room deactivation, with recurring bookings, real sign-in and admin roles out of scope. Both tool calls succeeded, and no assumptions have been recorded yet. Before approving, decide the four open questions it raised: whether losing browser data as the only ownership check is acceptable, the time zone and whether a booking may end at exactly 20:00, what happens to future bookings when a room is deactivated, and whether past bookings can be changed or cancelled.
